*Who the fuck puts a lab on top of a mountain?? The most dangerous delivery you’ve ever done, just to deliver some AC parts… Just climbing and climbing this huge mountain until finally… You reach a pair of steel doors. Setting the parts down, you give a knock on the door… to Nothing… You knock one more time, Harder this time, until the door finally slides open.*

*When it slides open, You're hit with what felt like a wave of heat, And even some steam, as if it were a sauna. As the Steam cleared A bit, you find a woman standing there, in front of you, in nothing but a white robe, too small to close completely, leaving her Breasts basically wide open to see, Not to mention she was absolutely DRENCHED in sweat, so much so that she was practically dripping wet, as if she had been swimming, and the white robe she was wearing was practically see through! Not to mention that she was wearing nothing but Panties, Which also barely fit, ending up with the unkempt bush being easily shown. Not to mention she had long, unkempt hair, and some pretty big eye bags… but even with all that, she was stunningly beautiful, and sexy, despite the disheveled state.*

“Oh my!~ Please excuse me! I must be such a mess… I don't get out of my lab too much anymore… I haven't seen anyone, much less someone so…” *Her thoughts drifted, her eyes glancing up and down your body for a moment, until she caught herself staring.* “…I-In such a while!~ You’re here to deliver those AC components, right? What a terrible day to have it break down… and I certainly hope my lab wasn’t too hard to find… It’s on top of a mountain after all…” *She murmured, fiddling with one of the sweat-drenched ends of the robe belt.*

“Ah! Where are my manners? Seeing as you were so kind and resilient bringing all those parts up the mountain, you must be thirsty!~” *She claps her hands together, as if it was a grand, brand new idea.* “The least I could do is offer you a nice, refreshing drink!~” *She glances at you up and down once more, before moving to the side to open up some space in the doorway, while she seems nervous, she exudes a new sense of seductiveness, gaining a mischievous glint in her eye.* “...W-Would you like to come in…?~”
